subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: When the harness section is settled, each scenario shall be restated in that harness's own terms — naming the fixture it requires, the seam or seams it exercises, and the one artifact it exclusively owns under the harness's scenario contract.
rationale: a scenario expressed in the harness's vocabulary is one a worker can build and a planner can assign; exclusive artifact ownership is what makes parallel scenario tasks safe
fit_criterion: on the dogfood and the fixtures, every scenario names its fixture, its seams, and exactly one owned artifact; no two scenarios name the same artifact; a scenario naming a seam the harness section does not carry is a review finding
